scope: Sanitized derivatives of already-retained observations; no new native/HTTP/SSH experiment. Placeholder files are not deployable configs. Different controls are separate historical runs, not asserted identical environment.

settings.apache_config_sanitized:
ServerRoot "<TASK>"
ServerName localhost
Listen 127.0.0.1:18087
PidFile "<TASK>/httpd.pid"
DefaultRuntimeDir "<TASK>/tmp"
ErrorLog "<TASK>/logs/error.log"
LogLevel warn
ServerTokens Prod
ServerSignature Off
LoadModule mpm_worker_module "<TASK>/apache/usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_mpm_worker.so"
LoadModule authz_core_module "<TASK>/apache/usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_authz_core.so"
LoadModule authz_host_module "<TASK>/apache/usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_authz_host.so"
LoadModule alias_module "<TASK>/apache/usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_alias.so"
LoadModule dir_module "<TASK>/apache/usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_dir.so"
StartServers 1
ServerLimit 1
ThreadLimit 25
ThreadsPerChild 25
MinSpareThreads 25
MaxSpareThreads 25
MaxRequestWorkers 25
MaxConnectionsPerChild 0
DocumentRoot "<TASK>/www"
<Directory "/">
    AllowOverride None
    Require all denied
</Directory>
<Directory "<TASK>/www">
    Require all denied
</Directory>

LoadModule _1cws_module "<PLATFORM>/wsap24t.so"
Alias /jet "<TASK>/publish/jet/"
<Directory "<TASK>/publish/jet/">
    AllowOverride None
    Options None
    Require all granted
    SetHandler 1c-application
    ManagedApplicationDescriptor "<TASK>/publish/jet/default.vrd"
</Directory>

User <TASK_USER>
Group <TASK_GROUP>


LogFormat "%U|%f|%R|%>s" routing
CustomLog "<TASK>/logs/routing.log" routing
